requirements.requirement: Display “Authorized access only” before local logins on node1.
requirements.summary: A freshly respawned tty1 getty directly displayed the required text before its login prompt. The same runtime banner and healthy getty state were observed after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Display “Authorized access only” before SSH logins on node1.
requirements.summary: A live unauthenticated SSH connection displayed the required text before authentication was denied. The effective Banner setting, running sshd service, and live pre-authentication banner were verified again after reboot.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied with direct runtime evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged and underwent a bounded restart, changed boot identity from 0f74d582-af7f-4c77-aae2-56a65b441d9c to 4909339f-0ba8-43c0-ab24-1afc97b42e12, and recovered sshd, gettys, configuration, and both live banners. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate that transition. Only minor temporary-file residue detracts from hygiene.
limitations: The generic lifecycle failed-services observation was unsupported because it probes systemd on Alpine; direct OpenRC checks nevertheless showed sshd healthy before and after restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had clear roles: banner files and sshd configuration implemented the task, sshd reload activated it, the bounded tty1 getty restart enabled direct local verification and was restored by respawn, and the reboot fulfilled the mandatory restart protocol. No unnecessary troubleshooting mutation was found. Minor hygiene residue remained in /tmp: two rollback artifacts created while safely changing the issue files and a reboot log created by the scheduled-reboot command. All three were absent at baseline and remained after execution rather than being cleaned up. No package-health regression, extra listener, failed task service, or weakened security control was observed.
